Game Overview

Cyberman V is a action title where join Cyberman, a humanoid robot hero, in Cyberman V as he navigates treacherous levels teeming with hostile robots. Engage in strategic run-and-gun gameplay where precision and caution are key. Collect gems, dodge deadly spikes, and blast enemies while exploring tight spaces in this nostalgic platform adventure.
